name: Parquet
author: Erin Carter
description: A floor of beveled rounded-rect planks, each pivoting ninety degrees on its own timer so the parquet endlessly re-lays itself — lit chamfers and shadowed edges giving every tile real depth. Crisp, kinetic, architectural.

params.label: Tile count
params.effect: How many tiles span the frame; low is big bold planks, high a fine parquet.

params.label: Rounding
params.effect: Corner rounding of the planks; 0 is sharp rectangles, high is pill-shaped.

params.label: Bevel
params.effect: Depth of the chamfered edges; low is flat tiles, high deeply raised.

params.label: Flip rate
params.effect: How often tiles pivot ninety degrees; 0 freezes the layout.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer flips nearby tiles; 0 ignores the mouse.
